text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
scratch = Path('/private/var/folders/cs/vgp_x_353zd9frkjpysp7zdw0000gn/T/kntnt-native-session-hr_evylq/scratch')
private = scratch / 'redline-mechanical-lvoq72mj'
evidence = scratch / 'observer-evidence'
evidence.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
shutil.copyfile(private / 'input.md', evidence / 'mechanical-pass-input.md')
shutil.copyfile(private / 'output.md', evidence / 'mechanical-pass-output.md')
assert (evidence / 'mechanical-pass-input.md').read_bytes() == (private / 'input.md').read_bytes()
assert (evidence / 'mechanical-pass-output.md').read_bytes() == (private / 'output.md').read_bytes()
(private / 'input.md').unlink()
(private / 'output.md').unlink()
private.rmdir()
reply = 'No changes needed after review and proofreading. Reviewed as a case study in American English (`en_US`), with no technique, as specified in the metadata.'
(scratch / 'observer-response.md').write_text(reply, encoding='utf-8')
assert not (scratch / 'observer-delivered.md').exists(), 'No artifact was delivered'
remaining = sorted(p.name for p in scratch.iterdir())
print('Scratch entries after cleanup:', remaining)
assert remaining == ['observer-evidence', 'observer-response.md'], 'Unexpected temporary work remains'
print('Mechanical captures saved; no delivered artifact capture created.')
PY",max_output_tokens:1000}));
